## Purpose

KEEL (Key Evidence on Eroding Leverage) tracks free public data on whether the conditions for gradual disempowerment are present: the scenario in which economies, states and cultures stop needing people and so stop serving them, without any single dramatic event. Each indicator page shows the data, how it is calculated, what it does and does not show, and what would change our reading. The [methodology](methodology.qmd) explains how the indicators fit together and how readings will work.

These indicators show whether the conditions for disempowerment are present. They do not show whether it is happening.

## About the author

KEEL is developed and maintained by [Jeremy Richardson, Ph.D.](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeremy-richardson) He writes about what the AI transition means for jobs and the economy on his Substack called [Working Through the AI Transition](https://richardsonlj.substack.com/).

## How to cite

Richardson, J. (2026). *KEEL: Indicators of Gradual Human Disempowerment*. https://richardsonlj12.github.io/keel/ (accessed [date]).

Each indicator page links to its data as CSV files. Please cite the original source of any series as well; each page describes its data under "Data and calculation" and lists sources and licenses under "Method".

## Report an error or give feedback

We welcome constructive and honest feedback on this project.

- **Report an error** ([GitHub Issues](https://github.com/richardsonlj12/keel/issues/new?template=error-report.md)): for a factual mistake in data, figures or sources. Public; needs a free GitHub account.
- **Join the discussion** ([GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/richardsonlj12/keel/discussions)): for questions about the method, interpretation or ideas, in an open conversation others can read and add to. Public; needs a free GitHub account.
- **Send private feedback** ([feedback form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJn9K0revpwU1sWM-WPmqlPtw80JVSuR9lIzcPktXqY7e3Tg/viewform)): for anything else, or if you'd rather not post publicly. No account needed.
